root_cause.primary: RSI crossover condition simplified in backtest engine
root_cause.change_description: Original detectSignal required rsiCrossUp/rsiCrossDown (previous candle RSI vs MA comparison). Backtest engine calculateSignal simplified to rsi > 50 && rsi > rsiMa (no crossover required).
root_cause.original_logic: rsiCrossUp = rsiPrev <= rsiMa && rsi > rsiMa; rsiCrossDown = rsiPrev >= rsiMa && rsi < rsiMa; rsiPassBull = rsiCrossUp && rsi > 50; rsiPassBear = rsiCrossDown && rsi < 50
root_cause.current_logic: rsiPassBull = rsi != null && rsi > 50 && rsi > rsiMa; rsiPassBear = rsi != null && rsi < 50 && rsi < rsiMa
root_cause.impact: Simplified RSI condition triggers on many more candles where RSI is merely on the right side of 50, without requiring an actual crossover event. This causes 38 -> 3,978 trade explosion.
root_cause.verification: Backtest engine produces 3,978 trades with simplified RSI; original strategy logic would produce ~38 trades with crossover requirement
